SYMPTOM: CSS :hover, onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave, NSCursor changes all fail on transparent Tauri overlay windows on macOS

CAUSE: macOS transparent windows use pixel-level hit testing in WebKit — transparent pixels (alpha=0) are pass-through for all mouse events. body/html background rgba(0,0,0,0.01) gets rounded to 0 by WebKit. setIgnoresMouseEvents:true/false and setAcceptsMouseMovedEvents:true don't help. NSCursor.set gets immediately overridden on next mouse move by the OS.

FIX:
1. HOVER: Rust background thread polls NSEvent.mouseLocation every 60ms, compares to NSWindow frame, emits 'overlay_hover' Tauri event (bool) when state changes. Frontend useEffect listens to this event.
2. CLICKS: CGEventTap with NSLeftMouseDown mask intercepts clicks globally. If cursor over overlay frame, consume event + trigger recording. Returning None from CGEventTap callback is BROKEN in core-graphics crate — must instead call event.set_type(CGEventType::Null) and return Some(event) to consume.
3. CURSOR: Impossible — setIgnoresMouseEvents:true means OS resets cursor on every mouse move regardless.

PREVENT: Don't waste time on CSS hover, HTML body background hacks, or NSCursor for transparent pass-through windows.
